summary.name: 小洽 XChat
summary.one_liner: XChat (小洽) is a Chinese online customer service system with an AI chatbot that answers website visitors around the clock and captures sales leads.
use_cases: capturing visitor contact info as sales leads
syncing leads to CRM or enterprise WeChat
validating phone numbers collected from chats
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a chat system where welcome messages and dialogue flows can be configured by visitor keyword, region, or URL to proactively start conversations. The bot extracts contact details, names, projects and regions from chats, creates business cards, and pushes them to a CRM, enterprise WeChat or email. It also checks whether entered phone numbers are invalid or disconnected and prompts users to correct them. Other stated features include role-based permissions, operation logs, encrypted transmission, private deployment, and connectors for third-party CRM platforms. The bot is said to learn a knowledge base automatically from chat history and supports customizing multi-turn conversations.
notable: Automatic lead extraction from chats with CRM, enterprise WeChat or email routing
Private (on-premise) deployment option for data security
Knowledge base generated automatically from chat logs
Claims savings of up to 90% on customer service labor costs
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; contact phone is the only sales route shown
The 90% labor saving is a vendor claim, not independently verified
Listing describes it as a freemium domestic 65B general model, but the page itself describes a customer service system and does not mention a 65B model
